name: wp-ja-kinetic/author-initials
title: Author initials chip
description: The single-article byline avatar (`.hx-author__av`): the source computes initials from the author's display name and renders a decorative span (`article/default.php:158-163`) — it never checks for a Gravatar. Replaces the core `wp:avatar` block (a real Gravatar image) with the same computed-initials text the source always shows on this one view.
